chunks: Some of the companions of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “O Messenger of Allah, why is it that we feel toward our children what they do not feel toward us?”
So he said: “Because they are from you, and you are not from them.”

key_terms.أَصْحَابِ: companions of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نَجِدُ: we feel or find within ourselves

ai.seo_question: Why do parents feel more affection for their children than children feel for their parents?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the natural intensity of parental affection toward children. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم attributes it to the fact that children originate from their parents, while parents do not originate from their children.
